notes.title: Achievements are Working!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

We've just released a new patch that fixes the issue where some players weren't receiving achievements. Your achievements should now be unlocking as expected! Thanks for your patience and support. If you encounter any further issues, don't hesitate to reach out. Keep playing and enjoy earning your rewards! 🎮🏆

#Update #BugFix #Achievements

notes.title: 🛠️ Game Update - Bug Fixes and Improvements 🎉
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players!

We are excited to announce the release of a new update for our game. In this update, we have fixed a bug that some players encountered when purchasing film in the inventory. This feature now works correctly and without errors.

We also fixed the names of items in the inventory to make your gaming experience more comfortable and understandable.

Thank you for your support and patience! Please continue to share your feedback so we can further improve the game.

Best regards,
Furry Tails Team

notes.title: Take your camera and get ready! 📸🏝
notes.notes:
The game is finally out, and we took notice of all of your feedback on our previous release - we took a big break before that, and it was one kind of task to get back into the process - but we're trying our best! 

We hope you'll enjoy this new journey - this time it fits the atmosphere around since you'll find yourself in the shoes of a tourist at the resort. As the beauty contest unravels, you decide to help both yourself and local hotties by making the best photoshoots imaginable. 

You have a lot of time and ambitions, so don't forget to earn some to buy proper equipment, and to earn every heart on your way as well! It's time to master the art of erotic photography - and as a grant from island management we present you a few free keys!

notes.title: Share your opinions and let us know what you think! 🥥
notes.notes:
Tell us who you like the most while spending time at the resort? Maybe sparkly Daisy, who's like a small ginger battery?Is it Alice, being somewhat opposite to Daisy, acting all mysterious, elegant and leaving a dignified feeling after herself? Let us guess, it's Claire - straight to the point, a direct and ambitious girl always on the lookout for the next goal to achieve. Or is it someone else after all? Who's your favourite? 
Also, let us know what felt lacking for your favourite character - maybe a certain photoshoot, or an outfit that would suit her better than anything in the world?If there's enough votes and discussion on a particular character, we'll consider making something special just for the fans, so we're eager to hear your feedback on the resort and its inhabitants!

notes.title: Hello, dear furheads! We've got something for you! 🎁
notes.notes:
A new release is already there! Although it took us some time to get back from the big pause, and some of our fans didn't enjoy certain decisions we made in the recent Furry Hitler 2 - we listened to everyone. We've worked on fixing certain aspects, and while the previous release was a nod to our original community, this one is a new, original idea. Not only fresh but hot and filled with a summer atmosphere, just as the time of the year suggests - welcome to the FURRY Sex Resort 🏝🔞!
- Compete in a strict world of nude photography
- Build important relationships and find a way to everyone's soul
- Immerse yourself in a storyline weaved around connections, tension
- Hot summer vibes and summer hotties vibe 😉

Jump on the game page and see for yourself! You also might get in time for a little bonus - who knows?
